Initial release of client-background-check: a comprehensive background investigation assistant from a sales/business development perspective.

- Quickly generates in-depth reports on clients’ procurement history, supplier landscape, budget estimates, and recent projects based on nationwide bidding data.
- Supports both single-company deep dive and two-company side-by-side comparison.
- Ensures responsible API use: automatic registration only after user consent, clear disclosure of scoring costs, and strict compliance with data integrity and privacy.
- Distinct tool routing: background check (company input) vs. bid decision (project input) vs. opportunity radar (market search) vs. simple bidding data search.
- Provides ready-to-use, shareable HTML reports and actionable next steps after each query.
- User-centric: zero manual configuration for trial, clear scenario re-direction, and strong compliance guardrails for data use and privacy.
